content.short: Tenderly Sandbox is a code editor designed as a friendlier environment for beginning developers.
content.description: Tenderly Sandbox provides a side-by-side development workspace for building both smart contracts and scripts. It supports Solidity for contract code and JavaScript for scripting tasks. Tenderly's infrastructure compiles Solidity, while JavaScript runs in the browser, delivering fast, in-context feedback as you work. When you save a contract or script, you can generate a unique, shareable link to it for easy collaboration or review with others. This setup streamlines development and sharing across teams.
